# Syed Muhammad Haris (carnoba)

> Syed Muhammad Haris (@carnoba) is a Data Scientist, AI Engineer, and Commercial Operations Lead based in Karachi, Pakistan. He builds quantitative systems, machine learning pipelines, and autonomous agents grounded in commercial realities.

## Identity & Education

- **Name:** Syed Muhammad Haris (carnoba)
- **Age/Born:** 19 years old, born May 3, 2007
- **Location:** Karachi, Pakistan
- **Education:** Pursuing B.S. Artificial Intelligence at Dawood University of Engineering & Technology (DUET, 2026–2030)
- **Prior Education:** Pre-Engineering, Govt Degree College SRE Majeed (2024–2026)

## Flagship Open-Source & AI Systems

- **[FINRIX](https://pypi.org/project/finrix/)**: `pip install finrix` (v1.0.7 on PyPI). XAUUSD TFT + Modal A10G + FinBERT + 14-strategy backtester + 207 unit tests.
- **Sisilic OS**: PyQt6 semiconductor BOM & wafer tracking system.
- **Nexly**: CrewAI + Gemini B2B lead generation system.
- **[ApexRetail Analytics](https://github.com/carnoba/apex-analytics)**: Interactive Python & Streamlit BI portal with live filtering, executive takeaways, and CSV export.
- **AI Receptionist & Appointment Handler**: Built with Retell AI, n8n, and Make.com.
- **[FREE-google-maps-scraper-bot](https://github.com/carnoba/FREE-google-maps-scraper-bot)**: Open-source Google Maps scraping tool.
- **Real-Time NYC Taxi Surge Pricing Engine**: PySpark & XGBoost on 2.8M+ records.
- **Carnix Network**: Community with 2,600+ members; custom Discord server architecture & bot development (role/permission hierarchies, automated moderation & verification bots, ticket workflows, live tier-testing queues) — now archived/retired after a multi-year run.
- **Easy Cash**: Financial/commercial project.

## Beyond Code & Extracurricular Achievements

- **Competitive Chess & Tactical FPS**: Competitive speed and rapid chess player (1342 Bullet, 1256 Rapid, 1445 Peak Bullet); topped multiple competitive leagues including 1st place in Crystal Division on Chess.com. Also enjoys tactical FPS gaming (CS:GO) for high-pressure split-second decision-making and team coordination.
- **Minecraft PvP Mastery & Tournament Operations**: Reached LT2 (Low Tier 2) in Netherite Potion (NethPot) — a rare high-skill mechanical milestone — while maintaining HT4+ (High Tier 4 or above) across all competitive PvP modes and regularly dominating outnumbered 1vX team engagements. Mentored, trained, and tier-tested 2,600+ players and hosted large-scale competitive tournaments for community engagement through Carnix Network; architected custom Discord server infrastructure (role/permission hierarchies, automated moderation & verification bots, ticket workflows, live tier-testing queues) for 2,600+ active members (now archived/retired after a multi-year run).
- **YouTube, 2D Stick-Fight Animation & Design**: Produced and edited YouTube content with a flagship video surpassing 110,000+ views. Passionate about crafting 2D stick-figure fight animations, video editing (CapCut, Filmora), and graphic design in Adobe Photoshop.
